features: INNOVATIVE DESIGN: The ground beef smasher features a 5-blade head design, making it easier to chop and shred potatoes, yams, squash, squash, kohlrabi and other foods than other products with three or four blades.

FOOD-GRADE MATERIALS: Our ground meat choppers are made of very strong nylon material, BPA-free, non-stick, odorless, and heat-resistant up to 447°F; safe for use with all types of cookware, including non-stick and Coated pan.
EASY TO HANDLE: Press blade into deli mash until desired consistency; angled blade scrapes sides of bowls and jars as you mix and mash.
EASY TO CLEAN: Meat masher has a stain-resistant design, non-stick surface, just rinse with water to clean grated burger utensils, dishwasher safe.
GREAT GIFT CHOICE: This meat spatula chopper grinds and chops a variety of meats for quick cooking, and it's also a great gift for your family on Mother's Day.
